title: Payment Evaluation Signal
description: A payment evaluation signal with evaluated_at, risk_level, and score fields.

evaluated_at.description: The time when this signal was evaluated.

risk_level.description: Risk level of this signal, based on the score.

score.description: Numeric score for this signal, returned with two decimal places. Possible values for evaluated payments are between 0 and 100, where higher scores indicate a higher likelihood of the signal being true.
